title: Declared inspection linkage assessment
boundary: Links caller-declared local records only. Inspection authenticity, organizational duties and signatures are not verified. Drafts remain unchanged; the five deliverable checks and deliverable numerical replay are not performed.
scopeLimit: This version supports all 1–8 units of one first-round run and existing planar-control-point or height-control-section unit scores. It produces no sample or batch qualification.
offline: Runtime is offline; reading and saving are unavailable.
cancelled: Waiting cancelled. A submitted save may still complete; recover it from history.
counts: Expected {{expectedUnits}} · Linked scores {{linkedScores}} · Full unit results {{fullProfileUnits}} · Retained mappings {{satisfiedMaterialMappings}}/{{requiredMaterialMappings}} · Unresolved references {{unresolvedReferences}}
existingAssociation: Existing record linked after calculation; target association is caller-declared
exportFailed: Export failed; saving was not confirmed.
frozenPlan: Frozen linkage plan (targets and mappings are immutable)
scoreSelectionHint: Explicitly choose an existing unit score for each target. No latest or highest score is selected automatically. Missing scores may be saved as incomplete. Source reads are rate-limited; frequent reads may require waiting before retrying.
loadRetention: Load retention plans for this deliverable
reference: Exact evidence reference in scoring record
materialSelect: Fixed material requirement in retention plan
acknowledge: I confirm the complete selected unit set and explicit per-unit mappings. This declaration does not establish exhaustive materials, authentic inspections, stage completion or professional approval.
savedOnly: Saved-time result; dependencies are not replayed on this list. Opening rechecks current sources.

states.complete-full-profile-unit-results: Every target has a full-profile unit result
states.incomplete-full-profile-unit-results: Unit results missing, partial or unavailable

errors.validation: Request violates the exact linkage contract; check full sample order, mappings and score identities.
errors.not-found: Source missing or outside this project.
errors.stale: Project or deliverable changed; reload sources and create a new plan.
errors.integrity: Local records or recomputed results disagree; operation refused.
errors.conflict: Request key or plan digest conflict; original record retained.
errors.source-changed: Dependencies changed; original assessment retained. Create a new assessment.
errors.unsupported-scope: Unsupported scope: preserve all 1–8 first-round units with IDs of at most 160 characters.
errors.limit: Local storage or request limit reached.
errors.rate-limit: Source read budget exhausted; wait one minute and retry the original request.
errors.replay-environment: Replay environment mismatch; old record unchanged.
errors.invalid-response: Response binding or digest mismatch; cannot display as verified.
errors.request-failed: Operation was not confirmed; retry the original request or inspect history.
